items.alt: Opal’s native macOS browser with compact navigation, tabs and a themed new-tab page.
items.caption: Browse inside Opal on macOS. Tabs, extensions, recent pages and connection controls sit beside the player and reading library. Native UI capture with public demo recents.

items.alt: The corner update card offers Update, shows download progress, then offers Restart.
items.caption: Download in the background, then restart to install and reopen. Native UI preview with an illustrative next-version number; no live download is shown. Seamless restart installation is available for writable macOS app bundles.
